The '''Ancient ruins''' were an area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] that contained a large amount of pre-[[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]] ruined buildings at the time of the [[invasion of Ossus]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:AR" />
